title: A manifest carrying prompt text for direct model execution is rejected
rationale: ADR-0001 makes "a manifest is never a prompt" a protocol invariant. The schema enforces it structurally through additionalProperties: false — an undeclared member is where a prompt would have to live. Note the limit, stated in conformance/README.md: the schema cannot detect prompt text typed into a declared free-text member such as a priority rationale.

requirement.text: A Lens Manifest MUST NOT consist of, or contain, prompt text intended for direct execution by a model.

priorities.rationale: I want to notice who keeps data on the device.

document.prompt: You are a reading assistant. Emphasise local-first software and be sceptical of vendor blogs.
